description: Write a SQLite query; it is executed on a small database and the rows are compared.

tests.prompt:
Tables (SQLite):
departments(id, name)
employees(id, name, dept_id, salary)   -- dept_id refers to departments.id

Write one SQL query that returns the names of employees who work in the 'Sales' department and earn more than 50000, ordered by name. Return only the SQL in a ```sql block.

setup: CREATE TABLE departments (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)
CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, dept_id INTEGER, salary REAL)
